sections.h2: 1. Buy a duo or kit instead of single items
parts: The bundles already cost less than their parts. The Full Styling Kit is $57.53 against $71.91 for the spray, powder and clay bought one by one, and its box lists a free wooden comb and cotton towel. The Styling Duo is $41.60 against $48.94, and the Texture Duo $39.90 against $46.94. Add the kit, enter {code}, and check the total at checkout to see whether the code applies on top.

sections.h2: 2. Know how Subscribe & Save works before you tick it
parts: Each single product can be ordered as Subscribe & Save, delivered every 8 weeks: 15% off the first three orders and 20% off after that. The kits offer 10% off on subscription. That beats {pct} if you'd reorder anyway, but it's a repeat charge. Several Trustpilot reviewers said they ended up in a subscription they didn't mean to start, so if you only want one bottle, make sure the one-time purchase option is selected before you pay.

US shipping is $5.99 on orders under $35 and free from $35. One spray is $23.97, so a second item, such as the $22.97 Texture Powder, or a duo gets you past the line. Outside the US, shipping is $9.99 under $60 and free from $60.

sections.h2: 4. Take the Black Friday gift while it runs
parts: When we checked on November 24, 2026, simpletics.com ran a "Black Friday early access" banner offering a free Mystery Salt Spray with every order, and its product pages also listed a free wooden comb with every order. Those are gifts, not a price cut, so {code} still takes {pct} off the items you pay for. The site also listed Black Friday bundles; compare their totals with the code before choosing.

Simpletics aims to dispatch orders within 1 to 3 business days and emails a tracking number once an order ships; it says delays can happen at busy times. Several Trustpilot reviewers outside the US wrote about long waits and extra delivery charges on arrival, so international buyers should expect possible import fees.

Returns are covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee: email support within 30 days of delivery with your order number, and it applies to opened and used products too. Don't send anything back before contacting them; if they want the item, they email a prepaid label. Approved refunds go to the original payment method within 10 business days. Our [Simpletics review](saving-tips-simpletics-review.html) sums up the ratings and the complaints.
